results.title: Flashark - Auto Car Parts, Exhaust System, Headers, EGR & DPF Delete
results.text:
I’m pretty impressed overall. The packaging was top-notch. Everything arrived perfectly sealed, and there was no damage during shipping. 
 As far as the fitment goes, the headers were nearly perfect. However, I did run into a couple of small issues. First, I had to slightly modify the engine mount bracket to ensure a proper fit. It wasn’t a big deal, just a bit of adjustment needed. The other issue I encountered was with the O2 bung placement. I had to modify the firewall slightly to accommodate it, but again, it was a pretty straightforward fix and is required with mostly all aftermarket header replacements on these e46’s. 
 One thing I would recommend is to stick with OEM header gaskets instead of using the ones provided in the kit. The OEM gaskets seem to offer a better seal and fit, and heat protection for the upper plastic valve cover. 
 All in all, I’m very pleased with the headers. They’re a great upgrade for the E46, and despite the minor adjustments, the process was pretty painless.
results.summary: Flashark Racing sells auto parts such as exhaust systems, headers, and EGR & DPF delete kits. The reviewer was impressed with their headers for an E46, but had to make some minor adjustments for proper fitment.
